name: layout + living room, cinematic off
eval: (function(){ var T=window.__TW; T.setCine(false); T.setFurn([{t:'sofa',x:2.2,y:4.4,yaw:180},{t:'armchair',x:0.8,y:2.6,yaw:270},{t:'rug',x:2.4,y:2.8,yaw:0},{t:'table',x:2.3,y:1.2,yaw:0},{t:'bookcase',x:0.25,y:1.2,yaw:270},{t:'bed',x:4.6,y:7.6,yaw:0},{t:'wardrobe',x:3.4,y:6.2,yaw:270},{t:'curtain',x:5.9,y:7.6,yaw:90},{t:'piano',x:11.5,y:5.5,yaw:20},{t:'person',x:9.0,y:3.5,yaw:200},{t:'person',x:13.5,y:2.5,yaw:120},{t:'bookcase',x:16.0,y:8.8,yaw:0},{t:'curtain',x:17.9,y:4.0,yaw:90},{t:'rug',x:14.5,y:5.0,yaw:30}]); T.setParam('lisx',5.2/18); T.setParam('lisy',1.2/9); T.setParam('lisyaw',145/360); T.render(); return JSON.stringify({renderer:T.renderer, errs:T.errors.slice(0,3)}); })()

name: wait for the shaders
eval: (async function(){ var t0=performance.now(); while(window.__TW.cine().ok!==true && performance.now()-t0<60000) await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,100);}); return 'ready after ' + Math.round(performance.now()-t0) + ' ms, compile ' + window.__TW.cine().compileMs; })()

name: wait for photo
eval: (async function(){ var t0=performance.now(); while(!window.__TW.cine().converged && performance.now()-t0<30000) await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,200);}); return JSON.stringify(window.__TW.cine()) + ' after ' + Math.round(performance.now()-t0) + ' ms'; })()

name: idle after convergence
eval: (async function(){ var d0=window.__TW.draws; await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,1500);}); return 'draws over 1.5 s after converging: ' + (window.__TW.draws-d0); })()
